title: Brand Agent Reference
description: Reference to an agent declared in a brand.json, by its endpoint URL and agent ID. The field that holds the reference says which agent role it names.

url.description: Agent MCP endpoint URL. Callers comparing this URL against another value (e.g., resolving 'is this the brand's declared agent?' against a discovery cache) MUST canonicalize both sides per the AdCP URL canonicalization rules, not byte-equality. See docs/reference/url-canonicalization.

id.description: Agent identifier (useful for logging, multi-tenant platforms)
